calibration_selection: train indices floor(i*1047/64), i=0..63; no development or reserve inputs
target: per-layer sqrt(sum residual_l2^2 / sum input_l2^2) on the fixed training calibration windows
treatment: For each saved geometry state, copy same-seed ordinary state; in forward layer order 8,9,10,11 set fixed strength to old_strength*target_RMS/current_RMS; remeasure all layers after four updates
out_of_domain: Fail rather than clip, retry or search if any strength is outside (0,1] or a norm is zero/nonfinite
heldout_match: Development RMS mismatches are reported, never refitted or used for selection
publication: Every case, CE contrast, untouched-reference development RMS, categorical calibration/development mismatch bands, lineage IDs and verification; calibration and matched-control RMS operands, raw text, native traces, fitted strengths and individual learned weights stay private
